751-4289-4742.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-3249-3755-6887--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-6887--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

856-4247-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

728-1339-4063-6625.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1339-4063-6625-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.

Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.

Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4871-5220-5243-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5243-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4871-5220-5243-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

997-1429-4981.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

620-1429-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1497-3327-4613-7940.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4613-7940.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1643-2073-2099-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7692-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7692-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

1479-3861-7705.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

240-1849-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

141-944-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or command zone by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable, reduced by Planar Gate.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-4677-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-4677-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2428-2541-6824.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2161-4613-4968.description:
Activate Scion of the Swarm by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2136-3604-6567.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk with haste.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
2136-3604-6567.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 70 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

1445-4050-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4050-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

116-4890-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Dack's Duplicate on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Dack's Duplicate do not have summoning sickness.
116-4890-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Dack's Duplicate.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Dack's Duplicate.
Activate Dack's Duplicate by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

586-2292-5626-6112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1365-1379-3698-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-3698-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 2, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1211-2177-4368.description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Sudden Substitution by paying {2}{U}{U}, exchanging control of Selective Memory and target creature an opponent controls.
Resolve Selective Memory, choosing to have the opponent exile all nonland cards in their library due to Opposition Agent.

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Reveillark.
Activate Goblin Bomabrdment by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reveillark trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bomabrdment ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

703-2751-3807.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, its ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Swift Reconfiguration by paying {W}, attaching it to Astral Dragon and causing Astral Dragon to become a Vehicle artifact with no other card types.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's trigger from step 2, targeting Astral Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Astral Dragon's ability, creating two token copies of Astral Dragon that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger, targeting the nontoken Astral Dragon.
Resolve the first Astral Dragon token's trigger, creating two token copies of Astral Dragon that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 6.

322-2440-3263-3356-3550.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic land card in hand.
322-2440-3263-3356-3550.description:
If Flame Jab is in your graveyard, cast it for its retrace cost by paying {1} and discarding a basic land card, targeting Polyraptor.
Otherwise, cast it by paying {1}, targeting Polyraptor.
Resolve Flame Jab, dealing 1 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
The Polyraptor token enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Dinosaur you control.
If you cast Flame Jab from your graveyard, activate Groundskeeper by paying {2}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other target using Flame Jab.

757-1606-4235.notablePrerequisites: Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
757-1606-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it targeting Magosi and another land of your choice.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.
